organization.title: Organization Management
organization.description: Create organizations, invite members, and manage your team.

fileShare.title: File Sharing

realtimeChat.title: Real-Time Chat
realtimeChat.description: Communicate with members of the same organization.

motivation.title: Why I Built <appName />
motivation.description:
I started this project to structurally address increasingly complex domains and the limitations of reusability.
I also wanted to improve the front-end architecture and build the back end myself to deepen my understanding of collaborative systems.

problem.label: Problem
problem.description: As features increased, it became unclear where components and logic should belong.

solution.label: Approach
solution.description: Separate responsibilities and dependencies using Feature-Sliced Design (FSD).

goal.label: Goal
goal.description: Build a predictable and reusable structure that remains maintainable as features grow.

problem.label: Problem
problem.description: Changes to API specifications caused client type mismatches and additional manual synchronization work.

solution.label: Approach
solution.description: Generate code from the OpenAPI specification with Orval and distribute it through shared packages.

technology.title: How <appName /> Was Built
technology.description: These technologies were selected to solve the problems above while improving development productivity and type safety.

nextjs.title: Next.js & TypeScript
nextjs.description: Applied Feature-Sliced Design (FSD) to separate responsibilities between layers and build a predictable architecture.

tanstackQuery.title: TanStack Query
tanstackQuery.description: Uses generated API clients for server-state management and efficient caching.

elysia.title: ElysiaJS & Bun & PostgreSQL
elysia.description: Built an OpenAPI-based back end using Bun's fast runtime and Elysia's strong TypeScript support.

architecture.title: DDD & CQRS (Architecture)
architecture.description: Isolates business logic by domain with DDD and separates read and write responsibilities with CQRS to improve scalability and manage complexity.

sharedPackages.title: Shared Packages (Monorepo)
sharedPackages.description: Separates shared UI, Orval-generated API clients, database configuration, and i18n into independent packages to improve reusability and maintainability.
